title: Gentle colour in the icons
question: The page you kept, with a little colour and light in the icons themselves - the drop, the sun, the fork, the apple. Three amounts. Read the defect notes: the generator has started losing parts of the page, and those are mistakes, not proposals.

options.label: Light behind the icon
options.thesis: Each icon sits in its own small raised disc and a gentle colour glows out from behind it - blue behind the drop, amber behind the sun, green behind the fork, rose behind the apple. The glyph itself stays grey. This is the disc from your second reference, at icon size.
options.viewport: Four small coloured lights down the left edge of the screen.
options.risk: DEFECT: it dropped the macro labels under the tubes and gave every meal row a progress bar nobody asked for. The tubes also came back fatter and louder than the ones you approved.

options.label: Only the glyph
options.thesis: No glow at all: the drop is simply blue, the sun amber, the fork green, the apple rose. Colour in the icons and nowhere else, exactly the rule you set for the home screen.
options.viewport: The quietest of the three; the lit write-line is still the only light.
options.risk: DEFECT: the labels under the tubes are gone here too, so the numbers have nowhere to live. In a build they come back.

options.label: Glyph and glow together
options.thesis: The icon is coloured and the same colour leaks from behind its disc. The fullest reading of what you asked for.
options.viewport: Colour on the icon and on the white beside it.
options.risk: DEFECT, and a bad one: it moved the macro numbers out of the tubes panel and into the meal rows, so Breakfast now reads 'Protein 96 / 150 g'. Judge the icons only.
